title: S1g light language on hardware
why: Confirm the LED state colours and one legible dome gesture, in one session.

ops.note: read the dome BEFORE moving it: it has no home position
12 deg is the smallest legible gesture; below ~10.5 he silently ignores it (D-013)

teardown: leds returned to the status colour, dome left where it is (it has no home)
